Ayodhya Ram Temple reports alleged fund embezzlement during Maha Kumbh

Reports indicate that a significant amount of money was allegedly embezzled from the Ayodhya Ram Temple during the Maha Kumbh event. This occurred amidst a surge in devotees, which led to an increase in offerings. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) has reportedly been granted a 15-day extension to investigate the matter.
